rationale: The buyer is a concrete, named enterprise persona — FinOps analysts and cloud platform teams at companies with serious Azure AI spend — who already pay for tools like Apptio and CloudHealth, so willingness-to-pay is credible. However, the core solution requires real Azure API integration work (querying Cost Management + Foundry resource metadata, reconciling SaaS billing records) that goes well beyond a Claude prompt and a landing page, and ongoing delivery would require per-customer Azure credential management and data pipeline work that can't run fully hands-off. Both buildability_with_ai and operational_autonomy fall below build-gate floors, capping the stage at validate despite a genuine enterprise pain.
solution_plan: This would be a 'Azure AI Cost Attribution' report service: given a customer's Azure credentials (read-only Cost Management + AI Foundry API scopes), it pulls spend data and Foundry resource metadata, then Claude reconciles and labels each SaaS cost row with the originating Foundry resource, project, and team tag, emitting a CSV or Slack digest. BUILD challenge: integrating with Azure APIs securely (OAuth, least-privilege service principals) is non-trivial; a solo non-technical operator cannot set this up without a developer. SELL: target FinOps forums (FinOps Foundation Slack, Azure community), LinkedIn ads aimed at 'FinOps analyst' + 'Azure' titles; first validate with 5-10 interviews before building. MAINTAIN: even if built, credential rotation, multi-tenant data isolation, and per-customer Azure environment differences make ongoing support non-trivial. Honest verdict: this is a real problem with paying buyers, but the build and operate complexity is beyond a non-technical solo operator using only Claude + standard tooling — validate the demand first, then consider hiring a dev or partnering.
notes: Fails build_gates: buildability_with_ai=4 (below min 6) and operational_autonomy=4 (below min 7). Azure API integration and multi-tenant credential management require engineering beyond Claude + prompts.
